questions.prompt: What is the correct syntax to run onSave() when a button is clicked?
questions.explanation: Event binding wraps the event name in parentheses and runs a template statement: (click)="onSave()".

questions.prompt: What does the $event variable contain for a native DOM event?

options.text: The DOM Event object (with target, target.value, etc.)

questions.explanation: For native events $event is the DOM Event; for custom outputs it's the emitted value.

questions.prompt: What is the modern function for defining a custom event on a component?
questions.explanation: output() is the current recommended API; it replaces the legacy @Output() + EventEmitter pattern.

questions.prompt: Which binding runs submit() only when the Enter key is released in an input?
questions.explanation: The (keyup.enter) key modifier makes Angular filter for the Enter key so you don't inspect event.key by hand.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between [value]="x" and (input)="y($event)"?

options.text: [value] flows data into the element; (input) flows events out to your handler
(input) flows data in; [value] flows events out

questions.explanation: Square brackets are property binding (data in); parentheses are event binding (events out).

questions.prompt: After emitting from an output, which method actually sends the value to listeners (e.g. this.rated.____(value))?
questions.explanation: Call .emit(value) on the output to notify whoever is listening in the parent.
